AP Calculus AB — Unit 2 & 3 Study Guide: Differentiation
Test review — know these rules and be able to use them without a calculator.

Definition of the Derivative
f'(x) = lim h→0 [f(x + h) − f(x)] / h
The derivative is the slope of the tangent line and the instantaneous rate of change.

Power Rule
d/dx [x^n] = n·x^(n − 1)
Example: d/dx [5x^4] = 20x^3

Product Rule
d/dx [f(x)g(x)] = f'(x)g(x) + f(x)g'(x)

Quotient Rule
d/dx [f(x)/g(x)] = [f'(x)g(x) − f(x)g'(x)] / [g(x)]^2

Chain Rule
d/dx [f(g(x))] = f'(g(x))·g'(x)
Example: d/dx [(3x^2 + 1)^4] = 4(3x^2 + 1)^3 · 6x

Derivatives of Trig and Exponential Functions
d/dx [sin x] = cos x      d/dx [cos x] = −sin x      d/dx [e^x] = e^x      d/dx [ln x] = 1/x

Tangent Lines
The tangent line to y = f(x) at x = a is y − f(a) = f'(a)(x − a).

Practice Problems
1. Find the derivative of f(x) = 4x^3 − 2x + 7.
2. Find the derivative of f(x) = (3x^2 + 1)^4.
3. Find the derivative of f(x) = x^2 sin(x).
4. Find the derivative of f(x) = 5e^x + x^2.
5. Write the equation of the tangent line to y = x^2 + 3x at x = 1.
6. Find ∫ (6x^2 + 2) dx.
